entries.title: Job 35:2
segments: Thinkest thou this to be right, [that] thou saidst, My righteousness [is] more than God's?

entries.title: Job 35:3
segments: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? [and], What profit shall I have, [if I be cleansed] from my sin? {if...: or, by it more than by my sin}

words.text: will it be unto thee? [and], What profit
shall I have, [if I be cleansed] from my sin
? {if...: or, by it more than by my sin}

entries.title: Job 35:4
segments: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee. {answer...: Heb. return to thee words}

words.text: with thee. {answer...: Heb. return to thee words}

entries.title: Job 35:5
segments: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds [which] are higher than thou.

entries.title: Job 35:6
segments: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or [if] thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

words.text: thou against him? or [if] thy transgressions

entries.title: Job 35:7
segments: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

entries.title: Job 35:8
segments: Thy wickedness [may hurt] a man as thou [art]; and thy righteousness [may profit] the son of man.

entries.title: Job 35:9
segments: ¶By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make [the oppressed] to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 35:10
segments: But none saith, Where [is] God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

entries.title: Job 35:11
segments: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

entries.title: Job 35:12
segments: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

entries.title: Job 35:13
segments: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

entries.title: Job 35:14
segments: ¶Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, [yet] judgment [is] before him; therefore trust thou in him.

entries.title: Job 35:15
segments: But now, because [it is] not [so], he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth [it] not in great extremity: {he hath: that is, God hath} {he knoweth: that is, Job knoweth}

words.text: But now, because [it is] not [so], he hath visited
: {he hath: that is, God hath} {he knoweth: that is, Job knoweth}

entries.title: Job 35:16
segments: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
